approved_by: repository owner — explicit selection to publish Android, Windows and Linux
evidence: Release source bcdfd4538c625b7775664c42eef71353ca4d61d9 applies the owner-approved concise About copy to Android, Windows and Linux and removes release notes from every About view.
In-app update manifests now carry only a bounded features list; generators and promotion verification reject free-form or technical update copy.
Android 1.4.3, Windows 4.1.3 and Linux 4.1.2 use independent platform versions while the Windows and Linux tags point to this exact reviewed source commit.
Static product-copy checks, Android bundle verification, JavaScript and Python syntax checks, YAML parsing, provenance checks, signed update tooling tests and release-candidate tests passed locally.

Each tag workflow must still pass its complete platform UI regression, locked-data and audio verification, packaging, SBOM and attestation gates before it can create a Draft; promotion independently verifies every Draft asset before publication.
accepted_risks: PySide6 was unavailable in the local sandbox, so the full Windows and Linux UI suites are delegated to the mandatory fail-closed tag workflows.
This release changes application copy, notification policy and version metadata only; Quran, tafsir, recitation, font and other third-party content remain unchanged.
Windows executables intentionally have no Authenticode signature; patch integrity is provided by Ed25519 signatures and SHA-256 asset digests.
